subject.title: improve(swarm): close out wait, phase, and worker follow-ups

question: Should this maintainer-labeled PR merge on deterministic tests and CI alone, or should it provide redacted live Codex-harness and Control UI behavior proof first?
rationale: The branch changes a Codex runtime deadline and transient UI behavior; repository policy requires direct Codex contract inspection and real behavior proof, while the author has explicitly declined to add those artifacts.

options.title: Require live proof
options.body: Request redacted terminal or runtime-log evidence for `agents_wait` and a UI capture or recording showing phase and narrator behavior across a canonical refresh before merge.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: A responsible maintainer may explicitly waive the live-proof gate after independently confirming the upstream Codex contract and UI behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live proof
recommendation.body: Request redacted terminal or runtime-log evidence for `agents_wait` and a UI capture or recording showing phase and narrator behavior across a canonical refresh before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and supplied the current-head timeout-contract explanation and validation disposition.
